description: Public-domain Bible commentary for a verse or chapter, such as Clarke, Wesley or Barnes. Returns each work with its author, year, tradition and a label that says it is commentary and not Scripture. Give a verse ("Romans 8:28") for the full notes on it, or a chapter ("Romans 8") for short excerpts. Uses the reader's chosen commentaries unless works is given. Does NOT return Bible text (use read_passage).

works.description: Optional work ids from browse_library, such as clarke or wesley. Up to 12.

name: get_commentary
title: Get commentary
